_meta.basis: Built only from activities whose hours and prices were verified on the venue's own site (data/activities.json). No travel time is asserted here; the only transit figure quoted is The Met's own ~1 h 25 min M4 estimate for The Cloisters.
_meta.weekday_logic: Placement respects published closures: the Whitney is closed Tuesdays, so it sits on Mon and Fri; the 9/11 Museum is closed most Tuesdays, so it sits on Wed.
_meta.length_options: 7 nights (15–22 Feb 2027) is the priced baseline. A 14-night stay repeats this loop with the second week left open for starred dinners, shopping and weather contingency — nothing in week two is asserted as verified.
_meta.caveat: February weather can close outdoor plans. Central Park, the High Line and the Statue ferry all have no indoor substitute listed on this site yet — that is open question Q11.
_meta.prices_not_summed: No daily spend total is shown: adult admission is known, but restaurant prices are not verified, so a daily total would be a guess.
